hero-background-galaxy.webp.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: photoreal luxury electronics campaign BACKGROUND ONLY, panoramic landscape 12:5 aspect ratio, ideally 2400 x 1000 pixels. This will sit behind separately composited accurate product cutouts and editable website text, so DO NOT include any devices, lettering, logos, watermarks or people. Cinematic architectural studio photography, sophisticated art direction, natural physical textures, beautifully smooth gradients and immaculate detail, quiet luxury, no decorative graphics. The LEFT 44 percent must be very calm and uncluttered with generous negative space for a large heading; the right half contains an elegant abstract architectural/light composition, with the center-right at 72 percent width kept visually simple enough for a product cutout. Main subject is the light and environment. No rings, no neon tubes, no sci-fi grids, no visible text, no floating geometric icons. Color direction: deep sapphire blue, midnight navy and restrained violet reflections. An exquisite large curved translucent cast-glass architectural panel and softly folded satin-like glass surfaces on the far right, a low dark graphite horizontal surface along bottom, cool blue light softly grazing real glass and brushed metal, beautiful depth and a subtle diffuse blue volumetric light haze to the right. LEFT text zone remains rich near-black navy, not a bright gradient. Sophisticated rich color with a smooth dark backdrop, no pink. Empty product display stage, no physical product. Avoid a hard rectangular border or spotlight circle.
hero-background-galaxy.webp.export: RGB WebP; smaller derivative resized proportionally for mobile; no generative changes during export.
